videos.t: Can you wear a Croc on your head?

And to my surprise, this was my first project that went viral on a couple platforms. I knew I had found my sweet spot: making absolutely terrible ideas.
Most of my inspiration comes from objets from my childhood. I’m old enough to have seen when crocs first became really popular, went out of style, and then made a huge comeback. I’m not sure when the trend of putting crocs on pets’ heads originated, but it sure did inspire

videos.t: Something Came in the Mail for You…
videos.desc: Putting storage into this giant PEZ dispenser was the best way to justify having something take up so much floor space in my office. 😅 On a regular day, I’m actually storing a small Star Wars PEZ dispenser collection in them, just because I think it’s hilarious. Big PEZ for storing small PEZ! I don’t know if you can tell in the video, but there’s huge chips and cracks on the face/hair. I actually dropped the whole head last year at Open Sauce because I wasn’t paying attention while disassembling it. Whoopsie! But anywho, I’m trying to find new uses for this guy. Right now, he can only store 3i

3D printing is starting to become so much more approachable. I’ve always said that when ink printers came out, very very few had them in their home. Today, they’re practically a staple- like having a toaster. I feel like we’re nearing a point where everyone will have 3D printers in their home. Anyone can have access to creating art, making repair parts, or even building educational models.

Thank you to Creality for sending me this new printer.
Go check out the new @Creality3D  K2 lineup!

Model at the end designed by @ChrisPirillo  

#3dprinting #crealityk2combo #crealityk2

videos.t: I made a Ring Pop Lamp!
videos.desc:
Really happy with how this ring pop lamp turned out! But I think I could do even better. I think version 2 will use laser cut router templates and, most importantly, I’ll laser cut some red acrylic to make a faux stained glass sort of thing. I made a stained glass globe back in college using laser cut acrylic, so I actually have experience in this very specific idea😂
